title: High Bar Table with Stool for 4 People, Set of Table and 4 Chairs, Bar Furniture in White Marble and Silver Frame, Multifunctional Applicable Multi - Scenarios
feature_bullets: 1. This table with chair set can easily be used in your living room or dining area to create a corner bar space to have a drink alone at home or invite friends to the party, the kitchen bar chair can even be used for the temporary office.

2. The table and chair with a width of only 50 cm will not take up much space, the chair can be stored under the small kitchen table, it is overall lightweight and can be moved flexibly to meet your daily use needs.

3. The relative height of the Kitchen Table with Chair is more scientific, the fall of the two is appropriate and ergonomic, you can sit comfortably on the chair, lean on the kitchen bar, your feet can naturally sit on the crossbar of the chair, providing you with a comfortable sitting experience.

4. The construction of the High Bar Table is simple, the triangular metal bracket under the table and the crossbar at the bottom can ensure the stability of the bar table without shaking easily. The maximum load of the table is 80 kg and the chair is 80 kg.

5. The assembly step of the Haute Cuisine Table is simple, the package comes with instructions and assembly tools, you can finish the assembly in about 30 minutes. Kitchen Bar Table are transported in 200 pounds compression-resistant recyclable cardboard, which reduces the risk of transport damage and promotes sustainable development.

product_details.Assembly Instructions Description: Detailed instructions to assemble the table in about 30 minutes, supplied with assembly tools.
